attributes.context: The clause appears under Section 6, which is titled Electronic Funds Transfer.

extraction_text: If the Employer institutes an electronic funds transfer (EFT) system, employees may participate.

attributes.context: Appears in Article 26, Section 1, which requires over-the-road/line employees to keep time sheets or trip cards, requires daily time records for local cartage operations, and requires time clocks at terminals employing five or more people.

extraction_text: The Employer may substitute updated time recording equipment for time cards and time sheets. However, a paper trail shall be maintained.

attributes.context: Appears in Article 26, Section 1, which also requires employers to maintain sign-in and sign-out records at terminals and requires road drivers to record their names, home domicile, origin, destination, and arrival and/or departure times.

extraction_text: The Employer may computerize the sign-in and sign-out records. However, at all times, the Union shall have reasonable access to a paper record of the sign-in and sign-out records.

attributes.context: The surrounding text provides job-security protections for drivers affected by Intermodal Changes, including work opportunities, seniority treatment, layoff limits, and wage guarantees.

extraction_text: It is specifically agreed that a total of no more than ten (10) percent of the Employer's total active road driver seniority list as of April 1, 2003, shall be affected by the Intermodal Changes during the term of this Agreement.

attributes.context: The provision requires the Employer to support proposed Intermodal Operations with specific facts showing sufficient freight, and relocation is subject to Article 8, Section 6 of the NMFA.

extraction_text: Any road driver who is adversely affected by an approved Intermodal Operation and would thereby be subject to layoff, or who is on layoff at an affected domicile at the time an Intermodal Operation is approved, shall be offered work opportunity at other road driver domiciles within the Employer's system.

attributes.context: The provision also addresses seniority-based relocation and dovetailing when drivers are affected by more than one domicile.

extraction_text: The Employer shall include in its proposed Intermodal Operations specific facts that adequately support the Employer's claims that there will be sufficient freight to support the work opportunities the Employer proposes at each gaining domicile.

attributes.context: Appears in Article 6, Section 4, titled New Equipment. The section also provides that these provisions apply if a law change permits longer combination vehicles or aggregate weight increases of 8,000 pounds or more.

extraction_text: Where new types of equipment and/or operations for which rates of pay are not established by this Agreement are put into use after April 1, 2003, within operations covered by this Agreement, rates governing such operations shall be subject to negotiations between the parties. In the event agreement cannot be reached within sixty (60) days after date such equipment is put into use, the matter may be submitted to the National Grievance Committee for final disposition. Rates agreed upon or awarded shall be effective as of the date equipment is put into use.

attributes.context: Appears later in Article 6, Section 4, New Equipment, after the provisions for negotiating rates for new equipment or operations and resolving rate disputes through the National Grievance Committee.

extraction_text: Employees expected to use computers will be trained to use them and will be paid for all training time. Employees expected to use computers will be given sufficient time to learn to use them.

attributes.context: This sentence appears in the Sleeper Cab Occupants subsection of Article 8, Section 8, which addresses how many drivers may be in sleeper cab equipment and sets limits on master driver presence in the cab.

extraction_text: Only two (2) drivers shall be permitted in the sleeper cab equipment at any one time except in the case of emergency, an act of God, or where new type equipment is put into operation.

attributes.context: The parties recognize that Congress passed this Act in 1991 to promote a national intermodal transportation system.

extraction_text: Intermodal Surface Transportation Efficiency Act of 1991

attributes.context: This sentence appears in Article 16, Section 6, which requires new sleeper tractors purchased or leased after February 8, 1998 to have standard dual heat/air conditioning systems, while preserving the Company's ability to purchase newer technology before the Agreement expires.

extraction_text: This is not intended to preclude the Company from purchasing newer technology on future purchases, should such become available prior to the expiration of this Agreement.

attributes.context: These restrictions are tied to the stated intent to provide maximum job security to drivers affected by the use of intermodal service.

extraction_text: Therefore, the number of drivers on the affected seniority lists at rail origin points at the time an intermodal change becomes effective shall not be reduced during the term of this Agreement other than as may be provided in subsequent changes of operations. Drivers on the affected seniority lists at gaining domiciles at the time an intermodal change becomes effective, shall not be permanently laid off during the term of this Agreement.

attributes.context: The chunk ties a wage guarantee for bottom-25% drivers at gaining domiciles to redomiciling caused by implementation of an approved Intermodal Change of Operation.

extraction_text: In order to ensure that the work opportunities of the drivers at the gaining domiciles are not adversely affected by the redomiciling of drivers, the bottom twenty-five percent (25%) of the drivers at a gaining domicile shall not have their earnings reduced below an average weekly earnings of seven hundred dollars ($700). This seven hundred dollar ($700) average wage guarantee shall not start until the fourth (4th) week following the implementation of the approved Intermodal Change of Operation.
